• 	Train	500	shop	owners	
on business skills, shop 
management, market 
management committee 
function, and link them 
with traders’ association

• 	Earmark	and	allocate	15%	
space for women vendors 
in open sheds to be 
developed in 92 growth 
center markets

• 	Orient	market	
management committee 
and traders to support 
female shop owners and 
women vendors and to 
include them as members 
of traders’ associations

• 	Provide	support	
including separate toilets 
and safe water supply for 
women in the markets

• 	Provide	solar	energy	and	
piped water supply in 
pilot markets

• 	Provide	need-based	
training to 100 female  
shop owners
